message.content: {"rules":["Implementors of TrustedRandomAccess must ensure that the iterator's size_hint is exact.","Implementors of TrustedRandomAccess must ensure that size_hint is cheap to call.","TrustedRandomAccessNoCoerce::size may not be overridden.","All subtypes and all supertypes of Self must also implement TrustedRandomAccess. Consequently, an implementation for a type with non-invariant parameters generally cannot depend on trait bounds on those parameters, except bounds from the struct/enum definition itself or bounds involving traits with a similar subtype/supertype guarantee.","If Self: ExactSizeIterator, self.len() must always return results consistent with self.size().","If Self: Iterator, implementors must make <Self as Iterator>::__iterator_get_unchecked(&mut self, idx) safe to call under all of these conditions: (1) 0 <= idx < self.size(); (2) if Self: !Clone, the same index is never used more than once on self; (3) after the unchecked call, self.next_back() is called at most self.size() - idx - 1 times; if Self: Clone and self is cloned, this limit is calculated individually for self and its clone, with next_back calls before cloning counting for both; (4) after the unchecked call, the only methods called on self or any new clones are Clone::clone, Iterator::size_hint, DoubleEndedIterator::next_back, ExactSizeIterator::len, Iterator::__iterator_get_unchecked, and TrustedRandomAccessNoCoerce::size; (5) if self is coerced to a supertype T after the unchecked call, the same method restriction applies to the resulting value, including through multiple coercion steps, and the call counts for __iterator_get_unchecked(idx) and next_back are added across self and all successive coercion results and must remain within the bounds in (2) and (3).","Under the unchecked-access conditions specified above, __iterator_get_unchecked must not change the value returned by size_hint.","Under the unchecked-access conditions specified above, after __iterator_get_unchecked it must be safe to call Clone::clone, Iterator::size_hint, DoubleEndedIterator::next_back, ExactSizeIterator::len, Iterator::__iterator_get_unchecked, and TrustedRandomAccessNoCoerce::size on self, assuming the required traits are implemented.","Under the unchecked-access conditions specified above, it must be safe to drop self after calling __iterator_get_unchecked.","If Self is a subtype of T, self is allowed to be coerced to T, including through multiple coercion steps. Under the unchecked-access conditions specified above, this coercion must remain safe after __iterator_get_unchecked; post-call method restrictions and cumulative call-count bounds continue to apply to the resulting values."]}
